Comparison of the two Virtual Set 0 game-text states: the Set 0 master slip (preserved copy of 6 August 2016) and the errata slip (preserved copy of 4 July 2017). The 2018 PC card image prints the errata words with the E mark; the 2022 PC remaster ([[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) (Remastered)]]) prints the same words with the E1 mark; a change of the printed mark alone is its own column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
